blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 FAT、SAT 與到貨驗收 (RI) 的目的差異，以及三者在 C&Q 流程中的順序關係。
blocks.en: Understand how the purposes of FAT, SAT and Receipt Inspection (RI) differ, and the order in which the three occur in the C&Q process.

blocks.zh: 掌握系統啟動 (System Start-Up) 的四步驟流程與安全先決條件。
blocks.en: Master the four-step System Start-Up sequence and its safety prerequisites.

blocks.zh: 區分操作/功能測試 (Operational/Functional Testing) 與性能確認 (PQ) 的適用時機與差異。
blocks.en: Distinguish when Operational/Functional Testing applies versus Performance Qualification (PQ), and how they differ.

blocks.zh: 應用 Table 7.3 偏差管理矩陣，針對五類偏差情境採取正確處置行動。
blocks.en: Apply the Table 7.3 discrepancy management matrix to take the correct action for each of the five discrepancy scenarios.

blocks.zh: 說明 Chapter 8 驗收與放行 (Acceptance & Release) 的四種總結報告模式，以及「確效狀態」啟動的法規意義。
blocks.en: Explain the four summary report options for Chapter 8 Acceptance & Release, and the regulatory significance of the start of the "Qualified State".

blocks.zh: 中文解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FAT（工廠驗收測試）
blocks.en: Core Concept: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test)

blocks.zh: FAT（Factory Acceptance Test）是在廠商場所進行的安裝/功能測試，目的是「越早發現問題越好」。在設備出廠前發現缺失，修正成本最低、對工期衝擊最小。
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) is installation/functional testing performed at the vendor's premises, and its purpose is to find problems as early as possible. Defects found before the equipment ships are the cheapest to correct and have the least impact on the schedule.

blocks.zh: FAT 的法律意義：通過 FAT 代表廠商已履行合約責任，雙方共同簽署文件作為憑證。
blocks.en: Legal significance of FAT: passing FAT shows that the vendor has met its contractual obligations, and both parties sign the documentation as evidence.

blocks.zh: 比喻：FAT = 出廠品管
blocks.en: Analogy: FAT = factory quality inspection

blocks.zh: 想像你訂製一台客製化設備，FAT 就是在工廠「出貨前」的驗收。如果你把設備運回公司才發現問題，不但要支付運費來回，還要等修復時間——這在製藥廠的專案時程裡可能代價極高。
blocks.en: Imagine you order a custom-built piece of equipment. FAT is the acceptance check at the factory before it ships. If you only find a problem after shipping the equipment back to your site, you pay freight both ways and wait for the repair, which can be very costly in a pharmaceutical project schedule.

blocks.zh: 關鍵：拆卸運輸決定 FAT vs SAT 的測試分工
blocks.en: Key point: disassembly for shipping determines the FAT vs SAT test split

blocks.zh: 若設備需要拆卸後運輸（如大型 WFI 系統），則在廠商已測試過的項目中，部分需要在 SAT 重新測試（因為重新組裝可能影響原有的校驗結果）。相反，不受拆卸影響的測試結果可沿用 FAT 數據。
blocks.en: If the equipment must be disassembled for shipping (such as a large WFI system), some of the items the vendor has already tested must be re-tested at SAT, because reassembly may affect the original calibration results. Conversely, test results that are not affected by disassembly can be relied on from the FAT data.

blocks.zh: 這個拆卸/重組計畫必須在 FAT 時就事先文件化，作為 SAT 測試範圍的依據。
blocks.en: This disassembly/reassembly plan must be documented in advance at FAT, as the basis for the SAT test scope.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO practical application

blocks.zh: CDMO 接受客戶委託時，若客戶要求見證 FAT（通常是 Phase 3 或商業製造設備），必須事先確認：觀察人員資格、NDA 保護、拍照/文件限制，以及 FAT punch list 的所有權歸屬。
blocks.en: When a client commissions a CDMO and asks to witness FAT (usually for Phase 3 or commercial manufacturing equipment), the CDMO must confirm in advance: observer qualifications, NDA protection, photography/documentation restrictions, and who owns the FAT punch list.

blocks.zh: RI（到貨驗收）的重點
blocks.en: Key Points of RI (Receipt Inspection)

blocks.zh: 到貨驗收 (Receipt Inspection, RI) 是設備/材料抵達現場後的第一道查核，核對的是「對不對、完不完整、有沒有損壞」。
blocks.en: Receipt Inspection (RI) is the first check once equipment/materials arrive on site, confirming that they are correct, complete and undamaged.

blocks.zh: 確認廠牌、型號、序號符合採購規格
blocks.en: Confirm that make, model and serial number match the purchase specification

blocks.zh: 確認隨附文件（材質證明、校驗報告等）齊全
blocks.en: Confirm that the accompanying documents (material certificates, calibration reports, etc.) are complete

blocks.zh: 確認到貨狀況良好、標籤正確
blocks.en: Confirm that the goods arrived in good condition and are correctly labeled

blocks.zh: 不合格品需隔離管制，不得進入安裝流程
blocks.en: Nonconforming items must be quarantined and must not enter the installation process

blocks.zh: 比喻：RI = 網購收貨拆箱
blocks.en: Analogy: RI = unboxing an online order

blocks.zh: 就像網購收到包裹要當場檢查，RI 必須在到貨時立即執行。等到設備裝到系統裡才發現是錯誤規格，要拆卸更換的代價就大得多了。
blocks.en: Just as you inspect a parcel when it arrives from an online purchase, RI must be performed immediately on receipt. If you discover the wrong specification only after the item has been fitted into the system, the cost of removing and replacing it is much higher.

blocks.zh: 含未解偏差的系統仍可驗收
blocks.en: A system with unresolved discrepancies can still be accepted

blocks.zh: SAT 完成後，若有未關閉的偏差事項，在 Testing Coordinator 與 System Owner 共同批准的前提下，仍可先行驗收並移交。這是實務上常見的做法，但需要明確記錄未解項目及後續解決計畫。
blocks.en: After SAT is complete, if any discrepancies remain open, the system can still be accepted and handed over, provided the Testing Coordinator and System Owner jointly approve. This is common practice, but the open items and the plan for resolving them must be clearly recorded.

blocks.zh: 安裝驗證 (Installation Verification) 聚焦 CDE
blocks.en: Installation Verification focuses on CDEs

blocks.zh: Installation Verification 不是全面性的安裝查核——它特別針對系統風險評估中識別出的 CDEs（關鍵設計元素）。
blocks.en: Installation Verification is not a comprehensive installation check. It specifically targets the CDEs (Critical Design Elements) identified in the system risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 最重要的兩類查核：
blocks.en: The two most important types of check:

blocks.zh: 材質符合性：與產品/清潔劑接觸的部件，材質是否符合規格（例如：316L 不鏽鋼、電解拋光等）
blocks.en: Material compliance: whether parts in contact with the product or cleaning agents meet the specified materials (for example, 316L stainless steel, electropolished finish)

blocks.zh: 關鍵儀器校驗：溫度計、壓力計、流量計等的 calibration 是否完成且有效
blocks.en: Critical instrument calibration: whether calibration of thermometers, pressure gauges, flow meters and similar instruments is complete and valid

blocks.zh: 供應商培訓是通電的前置條件
blocks.en: Vendor training is a prerequisite for energization

blocks.zh: 對於含廠商提供控制系統的設備（如 PLC、SCADA），操作員、工程師、維護人員的培訓必須在通電之前完成，且有文件記錄。這不僅是安全要求，更是 GEP 的基本原則。
blocks.en: For equipment with a vendor-supplied control system (such as PLC or SCADA), training of operators, engineers and maintenance staff must be completed and documented before power-up. This is not only a safety requirement but a basic principle of GEP.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：PSSR（啟動前安全審查）
blocks.en: CDMO application: PSSR (Pre-Start-Up Safety Review)

blocks.zh: 製藥廠普遍使用 PSSR (Pre-Start-Up Safety Review) 作為正式清單。建議將 ISPE 的四步驟整合進 PSSR SOP，並要求：(1) 安全相關 punch list 全部關閉；(2) 消防/HSE 部門會簽；(3) 培訓記錄附件。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical plants commonly use a PSSR (Pre-Start-Up Safety Review) as the formal checklist. We recommend building ISPE's four steps into the PSSR SOP and requiring: (1) all safety-related punch list items closed; (2) fire/HSE department sign-off; (3) training records attached.

blocks.zh: 系統啟動四步驟（順序不可顛倒）
blocks.en: The Four Steps of System Start-Up (order must not be reversed)

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確規定啟動步驟必須依序執行，有強制前後依存關係：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly requires the start-up steps to be performed in sequence, with mandatory dependencies between them:

blocks.zh: 功能測試的核心原則
blocks.en: Core principle of functional testing

blocks.zh: 功能測試的目標是驗證系統在整個預期操作範圍內——包括正常條件與最差情境（worst case）——皆符合規格。
blocks.en: The goal of functional testing is to verify that the system meets specification across the entire expected operating range, including normal conditions and worst-case scenarios.

blocks.zh: 關鍵要素：
blocks.en: Key elements:

blocks.zh: 必須在安裝測試與校驗完成後才開始
blocks.en: Must begin only after installation testing and calibration are complete

blocks.zh: 涵蓋機械、電氣、自動化（PLC/SCADA）、HSE 等面向
blocks.en: Covers mechanical, electrical, automation (PLC/SCADA), HSE and other aspects

blocks.zh: 最終步驟通常是全負載測試（Full Load Test）
blocks.en: The final step is usually the Full Load Test

blocks.zh: 比喻：worst case 測試 = 壓力測試
blocks.en: Analogy: worst-case testing = stress testing

blocks.zh: 就像汽車要進行極端天氣路試，功能測試必須覆蓋上下限操作條件——例如 HVAC 在夏天最熱、冬天最冷時是否都能達到設計換氣次數。只在「平均值」條件下測試是不夠的。
blocks.en: Just as a car is road-tested in extreme weather, functional testing must cover the upper and lower operating limits. For example, the HVAC system must achieve the design air change rate on the hottest summer day and the coldest winter day. Testing only at "average" conditions is not enough.

blocks.zh: 7.3.4.2 QOT：需要 QA 介入的關鍵區分
blocks.en: 7.3.4.2 QOT: a key distinction that requires QA involvement

blocks.zh: Qualification Operational Tests (QOT) 與一般功能測試的最大差異：
blocks.en: The biggest difference between Qualification Operational Tests (QOT) and ordinary functional tests:

blocks.zh: 針對 CAs/CDEs 的功能測試 = 屬於確效活動
blocks.en: Functional tests of CAs/CDEs = qualification activities

blocks.zh: 必須有 Quality Unit（QA）監督
blocks.en: They must be under Quality Unit (QA) oversight

blocks.zh: 測試結果的偏差需走 QA 核准流程
blocks.en: Deviations in test results must go through the QA approval process

blocks.zh: 換言之，同一台設備的功能測試，與 CA 相關的部分屬於 OQ（操作確效），QA 必須介入；與 CA 無關的部分只是 commissioning，工程師可自行完成。
blocks.en: In other words, for the functional testing of a single piece of equipment, the part related to CAs is OQ (operational qualification) and QA must be involved; the part unrelated to CAs is only commissioning and can be completed by engineers on their own.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 製藥廠有一條蒸汽管路系統。蒸汽壓力是 CDE（影響滅菌效果）。問：測試「蒸汽管路自動切換閥門在異常壓力時的連鎖動作」屬於 QOT 還是一般功能測試？該如何處理？
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical plant has a steam piping system. Steam pressure is a CDE (it affects sterilization effectiveness). Question: is testing the interlock action of the automatic steam line switching valve at abnormal pressure a QOT or an ordinary functional test? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 答：蒸汽壓力是 CDE，與之相關的閥門連鎖動作直接影響滅菌安全性，因此屬於 QOT，需要 QA 監督，偏差需走確效偏差流程處理。
blocks.en: Answer: Steam pressure is a CDE, and the valve interlock action related to it directly affects sterilization safety, so this is a QOT. It requires QA oversight, and deviations must be handled through the qualification deviation process.

blocks.zh: PQ（性能確認）的三大特徵
blocks.en: Three Key Features of PQ (Performance Qualification)

blocks.zh: PQ（Performance Qualification）是確效三步驟中最接近「真實使用」的最後一關：
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification) is the last of the three qualification steps and the one closest to "real use":

blocks.zh: 使用真實產品或替代品（placebo）——不再只是用水或模擬介質
blocks.en: Uses actual product or a substitute (placebo), not just water or a simulated medium

blocks.zh: 驗證重現性——通常需要多次重複（如滅菌確效三次）
blocks.en: Demonstrates reproducibility, usually requiring multiple repeats (for example, three runs in sterilization validation)

blocks.zh: 在操作 SOP 下執行——驗證「人員按照 SOP 操作」也能達到規格
blocks.en: Performed under the operating SOP, verifying that specification is also met when personnel operate according to the SOP

blocks.zh: PQ 的先決條件鏈
blocks.en: The PQ Prerequisite Chain

blocks.zh: ISPE 規定的順序非常嚴格：
blocks.en: The order specified by ISPE is very strict:

blocks.zh: IQ 完成 → OQ 完成 → 工程測試/週期開發 → 制定操作 SOP → 執行 PQ
blocks.en: IQ complete → OQ complete → engineering tests/cycle development → operating SOP established → PQ executed

blocks.zh: 若跳過中間步驟（如未先完成週期開發就直接執行 PQ），稽核時將面臨重大問題。
blocks.en: If an intermediate step is skipped (for example, running PQ without first completing cycle development), serious problems will arise at audit.

blocks.zh: 比喻：PQ = 考試的「上機實作」
blocks.en: Analogy: PQ = the hands-on practical exam

blocks.zh: IQ 是核對「工具有沒有裝好」，OQ 是「操作手冊說得到嗎」，而 PQ 是「真正考試時，考生按照 SOP 操作，結果符合規格嗎」。PQ 失敗了，表示真實操作條件下系統仍達不到要求，整個放行流程必須暫停。
blocks.en: IQ checks that the tools are installed correctly, OQ checks that the system does what the operating manual says, and PQ asks whether, in the real exam, a candidate following the SOP gets results that meet specification. If PQ fails, the system still cannot meet requirements under real operating conditions, and the entire release process must be paused.

blocks.zh: Type 4 vs Type 5 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Difference Between Type 4 and Type 5

blocks.zh: Type 4（原因未知）：系統可能可以修復，但必須先調查根本原因。需要 QA 介入，發起調查，找到原因後修正並重測。
blocks.en: Type 4 (cause unknown): the system may be repairable, but the root cause must be investigated first. QA involvement is required: initiate an investigation, find the cause, then correct and retest.

blocks.zh: Type 5（根本無法達到）：這是最嚴重的情況。代表設計本身可能有缺陷，或規格設定不合理。必須有強力的科學論述（justification）說明為何在新的風險控制措施下系統仍可接受，或必須修改設計。
blocks.en: Type 5 (cannot be achieved at all): the most serious case. It means the design itself may be flawed or the specification unreasonable. There must be a strong scientific justification for why the system remains acceptable under new risk control measures, or the design must be changed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核警示
blocks.en: CDMO audit warning

blocks.zh: FDA/EMA 稽核員最常聚焦的問題：「這個偏差是否需要走 Quality Unit 流程？」若您的團隊將 Type 4/5 偏差誤分類為 Type 3，自行以工程變更關閉，而未通知 QA，這在 483 觀察或 Warning Letter 中屬於重大發現。
blocks.en: The question FDA/EMA auditors focus on most: "Does this deviation need to go through the Quality Unit process?" If your team misclassifies a Type 4/5 deviation as Type 3 and closes it by engineering change without notifying QA, this is a major finding in a 483 observation or Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: 設計負責人的法律義務
blocks.en: Legal obligations of the Design Authority

blocks.zh: 即使是 Type 2（SME 接受預期結果未達），設計負責人（Design Authority）仍有法律責任確保系統符合相關規範。「SME 認為可以」並不等於「合法合規」——當涉及建築/消防/壓力容器等法規要求時，不能單純由 SME 蓋章了事。
blocks.en: Even for a Type 2 deviation (an SME accepts that the expected result was not met), the Design Authority still has a legal responsibility to ensure that the system complies with the relevant regulations. "The SME thinks it is acceptable" does not equal "legally compliant". Where building, fire or pressure vessel requirements are involved, the SME cannot simply rubber-stamp it.

blocks.en: Quick Reference to the Five Deviation Types in Table 7.3

blocks.zh: 「確效狀態」啟動的法規意義
blocks.en: Regulatory Significance of the Start of the "Qualified State"

blocks.zh: QA 簽署驗收與放行文件的那一刻，正式宣告系統進入確效狀態（Qualified State）。這個時間點在法規上具有以下意義：
blocks.en: The moment QA signs the acceptance and release documents, the system formally enters the Qualified State. From a regulatory standpoint, this point means the following:

blocks.zh: 系統的任何後續更改必須走 QA 管理的品質變更控制
blocks.en: Any later change to the system must go through QA-managed quality change control

blocks.zh: 啟動持續績效監測程序
blocks.en: Ongoing performance monitoring procedures start

blocks.zh: 啟動定期審查週期（通常每年或每3年）
blocks.en: The periodic review cycle starts (usually every year or every 3 years)

blocks.zh: 系統所有權正式由專案團隊移交給操作/工程部門
blocks.en: Ownership of the system is formally transferred from the project team to the operations/engineering department

blocks.zh: 比喻：確效狀態 = 房屋完工驗收後的交屋
blocks.en: Analogy: Qualified State = handover of a finished house

blocks.zh: 在驗收放行前，設備是「建造中」——工程師可以自由修改。一旦 QA 簽字放行，就像房屋交屋後，任何改動都需要「裝修許可」（變更控制）。沒有經過正式的 QA 核准變更控制就動到系統，等同於未申報裝修——稽核時這是重大缺失。
blocks.en: Before acceptance and release, the equipment is "under construction", and engineers can modify it freely. Once QA signs the release, it is like a house after handover: any alteration requires a "renovation permit" (change control). Changing the system without formal QA-approved change control is like renovating without declaring it, which is a major deficiency at audit.

blocks.zh: 「非影響產品品質」偏差可帶著放行
blocks.en: Deviations that do "not affect product quality" can be released with the system

blocks.zh: 不是所有偏差都必須在放行前關閉。若偏差不影響產品品質，可以在以下前提下暫時開放：
blocks.en: Not all deviations must be closed before release. If a deviation does not affect product quality, it can be left open temporarily on the following conditions:

blocks.zh: 已有書面記錄的解決行動計畫
blocks.en: A documented action plan for resolution is in place

blocks.zh: 指定負責人與完成期限
blocks.en: A responsible person and completion deadline are assigned

blocks.zh: QA 正式批准此例外
blocks.en: QA formally approves the exception

blocks.zh: 進入 A&R 階段的入場券（Gate Criteria）
blocks.en: Entry Ticket to the A&R Phase (Gate Criteria)

blocks.zh: 驗收與放行不是自動發生的——需要確認以下五項：
blocks.en: Acceptance and release do not happen automatically. The following five items must be confirmed:

blocks.zh: 所有測試結果已被審查（不只是「有數據」，而是「有人看過並確認」）
blocks.en: All test results have been reviewed (not just "data exists" but "someone has looked at it and confirmed it")

blocks.zh: 非預期結果已被調查（不能視而不見）
blocks.en: Unexpected results have been investigated (they cannot be ignored)

blocks.zh: 偏差事項已被處理（不一定全部關閉，但都有行動計畫）
blocks.en: Discrepancies have been addressed (not necessarily all closed, but each has an action plan)

blocks.zh: 工程變更已關閉（或有 QA 批准的例外）
blocks.en: Engineering changes have been closed (or have a QA-approved exception)

blocks.zh: 偏差已透過工程變更管理或重測方式解決
blocks.en: Discrepancies have been resolved through engineering change management or retesting

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：A&R 準備會議 (Readiness Review)
blocks.en: CDMO practice: A&R Readiness Review meeting

blocks.zh: 建議在正式驗收前一到兩週召開「A&R Readiness Review」，以 checklist 逐一確認上述五個先決條件。這個會議的紀錄可作為後續稽核時「有履行前置審查」的證據。
blocks.en: We recommend holding an "A&R Readiness Review" one to two weeks before formal acceptance, using a checklist to confirm the five prerequisites above one by one. The minutes of this meeting can serve as evidence at later audits that the pre-release review was carried out.

blocks.zh: 8.3.1 測試文件的最低內容要求
blocks.en: 8.3.1 Minimum Content Requirements for Test Documentation

blocks.zh: ISPE 規定 Summary Report 必須包含五個最低要素：
blocks.en: ISPE requires a Summary Report to contain five minimum elements:

blocks.zh: 測試描述（做了什麼）
blocks.en: Description of the tests (what was done)

blocks.zh: 預期結果（預計要達到什麼）及是否達到
blocks.en: Expected results (what was meant to be achieved) and whether they were achieved

blocks.zh: 驗收標準及是否達到
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria and whether they were met

blocks.zh: 對應的測試協議和原始數據的參照
blocks.en: References to the corresponding test protocols and raw data

blocks.zh: 總結與結論
blocks.en: Summary and conclusions

blocks.zh: 這五項是最低要求，不是選項——若報告缺少任何一項，稽核員將會提出觀察。
blocks.en: These five items are minimum requirements, not options. If a report lacks any one of them, the auditor will raise an observation.

blocks.zh: 8.3.4 品質系統要素（Quality System Elements）
blocks.en: 8.3.4 Quality System Elements

blocks.zh: 這是容易被忽略的一環——設備測試過了，但這些「支援系統」沒到位，系統仍無法放行：
blocks.en: This is easy to overlook: the equipment has passed testing, but if these supporting systems are not in place, the system still cannot be released:

blocks.zh: SOP：操作程序書（版本正確、已批准）
blocks.en: SOPs: operating procedures (correct version, approved)

blocks.zh: 校驗/維護系統：設備已納入校驗計畫
blocks.en: Calibration/maintenance system: the equipment is included in the calibration program

blocks.zh: 日誌本：設備使用、清潔、維護記錄機制
blocks.en: Logbooks: a mechanism for recording equipment use, cleaning and maintenance

blocks.zh: 廠商文件：手冊、零件清單、維護要求
blocks.en: Vendor documentation: manuals, parts lists, maintenance requirements

blocks.zh: 人員培訓：相關人員已完成培訓並記錄
blocks.en: Personnel training: relevant personnel have completed and documented their training

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：Quality System Elements Checklist
blocks.en: CDMO application: Quality System Elements Checklist

blocks.zh: 建議建立一份設備放行前的「品質系統要素確認表」，在 A&R 報告中以附件形式附上，逐項確認是否就位。特別注意：SOP 必須是批准後的最新版本，草稿版本不能算「到位」。
blocks.en: We recommend creating a "quality system elements confirmation form" for equipment release, attached to the A&R report as an appendix, confirming item by item that each element is in place. Pay particular attention: the SOP must be the latest approved version; a draft version does not count as "in place".

blocks.zh: 工程變更 vs 品質變更控制的轉換點
blocks.en: The Transition Point from Engineering Change to Quality Change Control

blocks.zh: 在 A&R 完成之前，系統的變更可走「工程變更管理」流程（較快速，工程師主導）。一旦 QA 簽署放行，系統進入確效狀態，所有後續變更必須走 QA 管理的品質變更控制（較嚴謹，需評估影響確效狀態）。這個轉換點必須被清楚認識。
blocks.en: Before A&R is complete, changes to the system can follow the "engineering change management" process (faster, led by engineers). Once QA signs the release, the system enters the Qualified State and all later changes must go through QA-managed quality change control (more rigorous, requiring assessment of the impact on the qualified state). This transition point must be clearly understood.

blocks.zh: 四種放行方式一覽表（快速選擇指南）
blocks.en: The Four Release Options at a Glance (Quick Selection Guide)

blocks.zh: Option 1 — 委託委託摘要報告
blocks.en: Option 1 — Commissioning Summary Report

blocks.zh: 適用：無 CA/CDE 系統（間接影響）
blocks.en: Applies to: systems without CAs/CDEs (indirect impact)

blocks.zh: 文件：Commissioning Summary Report（一份文件搞定）
blocks.en: Documentation: Commissioning Summary Report (a single document)

blocks.zh: QA：不需要
blocks.en: QA: not required

blocks.zh: Option 2 — 確效摘要報告
blocks.en: Option 2 — Qualification Summary Report

blocks.zh: 適用：有 CA/CDE 的新系統，各項要求同時就緒
blocks.en: Applies to: new systems with CAs/CDEs, where all requirements are ready at the same time

blocks.zh: 文件：C&Q Summary Report（涵蓋所有要素）
blocks.en: Documentation: C&Q Summary Report (covering all elements)

blocks.zh: QA：必要，需簽名
blocks.en: QA: required, signature needed

blocks.zh: Option 3 — 透過變更控制放行
blocks.en: Option 3 — Release through Change Control

blocks.zh: 適用：已有確效狀態的現有廠房，新增或改造系統
blocks.en: Applies to: adding or modifying a system in an existing facility that already has a qualified state

blocks.zh: 文件：QSR + 變更控制記錄（品質系統要素在 CC 中記錄）
blocks.en: Documentation: QSR + change control record (quality system elements are documented in the CC)

blocks.zh: QA：必要（CC 核准等同放行）
blocks.en: QA: required (CC approval equals release)

blocks.zh: Option 4 — 整體 A&R 報告
blocks.en: Option 4 — Overall A&R Report

blocks.zh: 適用：大型互連系統（如新廠整體）
blocks.en: Applies to: large interconnected systems (such as a whole new facility)

blocks.zh: 文件：各系統獨立 SR + 整體 A&R Report
blocks.en: Documentation: an independent SR for each system + an overall A&R Report

blocks.zh: QA：必要，整體 A&R Report 的 QA 簽名 = 全部系統放行
blocks.en: QA: required; QA signature on the overall A&R Report = release of all systems

blocks.zh: 比喻：四個選項 = 四種房屋驗收模式
blocks.en: Analogy: four options = four modes of building acceptance

blocks.zh:
Option 1：工具間驗收（填個表格就好）
Option 2：單棟新建住宅驗收（一份完整驗收報告）
Option 3：現有大樓增建隔間（走建管申請/變更管理）
Option 4：整個新建社區驗收（各棟各自驗收 + 整體社區交屋文件）
blocks.en:
Option 1: Tool shed acceptance (just fill in a form)
Option 2: Acceptance of a single new house (one complete acceptance report)
Option 3: Adding partitions in an existing building (building permit application/change management)
Option 4: Acceptance of a whole new housing development (each building accepted individually + overall handover documents for the development)

blocks.zh: Option 4 的兩面性
blocks.en: Two Sides of Option 4

blocks.zh: 優點：反映製程風險評估的系統分組邏輯，消除跨系統整合的落差，批次記錄結構較一致。
blocks.en: Advantages: reflects the system grouping logic of the process risk assessment, eliminates gaps in cross-system integration, and gives a more consistent batch record structure.

blocks.zh: 缺點：一旦 Group 化，未來任何一台設備變更時，整個 Group 的文件都可能需要更新。稽核時若查某一台設備，可能要提供整組所有設備的確效文件——文件量龐大。
blocks.en: Disadvantages: once grouped, a change to any single piece of equipment may require updating the documents of the entire group. If an auditor examines one piece of equipment, you may have to provide the qualification documents for every piece of equipment in the group, which is a huge volume of documentation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 決策樹：我應該用哪個 Option？
blocks.en: CDMO decision tree: which Option should I use?

blocks.zh: 此系統有 CA/CDE 嗎？→ 否 → Option 1
blocks.en: Does this system have CAs/CDEs? → No → Option 1

blocks.zh: 此系統有 CA/CDE → 是否為現有廠已有 CC 流程？→ 是 → Option 3
blocks.en: Does it have CAs/CDEs → is it in an existing facility with a CC process? → Yes → Option 3

blocks.zh: 新廠 / 所有要素能同時備齊？→ 是 → Option 2
blocks.en: New facility / can all elements be ready at the same time? → Yes → Option 2

blocks.zh: 大型互連系統 / 多系統需分批放行？→ Option 4
blocks.en: Large interconnected system / multiple systems to be released in batches? → Option 4

blocks.zh: 「QA 簽名 = 確效狀態啟動」的法規里程碑
blocks.en: The Regulatory Milestone: "QA Signature = Start of the Qualified State"

blocks.zh: 這是整個 C&Q 流程最重要的時間點：
blocks.en: This is the most important point in the entire C&Q process:

blocks.zh: 商業意義：CDMO 可以開始在此系統上生產商業批次，向客戶收費
blocks.en: Commercial significance: the CDMO can start manufacturing commercial batches on this system and charging clients

blocks.zh: 法規意義：FDA/EMA 稽核時，確效狀態的起始日期 = QA 簽名日期
blocks.en: Regulatory significance: in an FDA/EMA audit, the start date of the qualified state = the QA signature date

blocks.zh: 運營意義：系統進入維護/監測週期，責任移轉給操作部門
blocks.en: Operational significance: the system enters the maintenance/monitoring cycle, and responsibility passes to the operations department

blocks.zh: 變更管理意義：任何後續修改都需要評估對確效狀態的影響
blocks.en: Change management significance: any later modification requires an assessment of its impact on the qualified state

blocks.zh: 比喻：追溯矩陣 = 施工管理清單
blocks.en: Analogy: traceability matrix = construction management checklist

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣就像蓋房子時的「施工進度追蹤表」——它幫助專案經理確認每個設計要求（URS）都有對應的設計（DR）和測試（C&Q），沒有遺漏。但最後法規要求的「合格」憑證是「驗收報告」，而非這張追蹤表本身。
blocks.en: A traceability matrix is like a construction progress tracker when building a house. It helps the project manager confirm that every design requirement (URS) has a corresponding design (DR) and test (C&Q), with nothing missed. But the "qualified" certificate that regulations ultimately require is the acceptance report, not the tracker itself.

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣「精簡原則」的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of the "Keep It Lean" Principle for Traceability Matrices

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調要「最小化」追溯矩陣的資訊量。這是因為過於龐大的矩陣在稽核時反而成為負擔——每次有任何設計變更，追溯矩陣都要同步更新，若文件過大，維護工作量呈指數增加，且增加稽核員找到矛盾點的機會。夠用就好，精準追溯才是目標。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically stresses minimizing the amount of information in the traceability matrix. An overly large matrix becomes a burden at audit: every design change requires the matrix to be updated in step, and if the document is too large, the maintenance effort grows exponentially and auditors have more chances to find inconsistencies. Enough is enough; the goal is precise traceability.

blocks.zh: 本節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 本節重點摘要
blocks.en: Key Points of This Section

blocks.zh: FAT（工廠驗收測試）在廠商場所執行，是最早期的驗證機會；拆卸運輸計畫決定哪些測試可沿用 FAT 結果，哪些需要在 SAT 重新執行。
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) is performed at the vendor's premises and is the earliest opportunity for verification; the disassembly/shipping plan determines which tests can rely on FAT results and which must be re-executed at SAT.

blocks.zh: RI（到貨驗收）必須在到貨時立即執行，不合格品需隔離；SAT（現場驗收測試）含 FAT punch list 審查，可附條件（有未決偏差）移交。
blocks.en: RI (Receipt Inspection) must be performed immediately on receipt, and nonconforming items must be quarantined; SAT (Site Acceptance Test) includes review of the FAT punch list and allows conditional handover (with open discrepancies).

blocks.zh: 系統啟動四步驟必須依序執行（步驟 1+2 先於步驟 3，步驟 3 先於步驟 4）；控制系統培訓必須在通電前完成。
blocks.en: The four steps of system start-up must be performed in sequence (steps 1+2 before step 3, step 3 before step 4); control system training must be completed before power-up.

blocks.zh: PQ（性能確認）使用真實產品/替代品，在操作 SOP 下執行，驗證重現性；高壓滅菌鍋、充填機、製藥用水系統等必須完成 PQ 才能放行。
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification) uses actual product/a substitute, is performed under the operating SOP, and verifies reproducibility; autoclaves, filling machines, pharmaceutical water systems and the like must complete PQ before release.

blocks.zh: Table 7.3 偏差管理：Type 4（標準未達、原因未知）與 Type 5（標準根本無法達到）為關鍵偏差，必須有 Quality Unit 介入。
blocks.en: Table 7.3 discrepancy management: Type 4 (standard not met, cause unknown) and Type 5 (standard cannot be achieved at all) are critical discrepancies and require Quality Unit involvement.

blocks.zh: QA 簽署 = 確效狀態啟動：這是 C&Q 流程最重要的里程碑，系統所有後續變更必須走 QA 管理的品質變更控制。
blocks.en: QA signature = start of the Qualified State: this is the most important milestone in the C&Q process, and all later changes to the system must go through QA-managed quality change control.

blocks.zh: 四種放行報告選項：Option 1（無 CA/CDE 系統）→ Option 2（有 CA/CDE 新系統）→ Option 3（現有廠透過 CC）→ Option 4（大型互連系統）。
blocks.en: Four release report options: Option 1 (systems without CAs/CDEs) → Option 2 (new systems with CAs/CDEs) → Option 3 (existing facility through CC) → Option 4 (large interconnected systems).

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣是有用的專案管理工具，但不是必要的獨立文件；應保持精簡以維持可管理性。
blocks.en: The traceability matrix is a useful project management tool but not a required standalone document; it should be kept lean to remain manageable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用總結
blocks.en: CDMO Application Summary

blocks.zh: 稽核準備：最常被查的問題
blocks.en: Audit preparation: the most frequently asked questions

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT 文件完整性：punch list 的每一項都有後續處理記錄嗎？
blocks.en: Completeness of FAT/SAT documentation: does every punch list item have a follow-up record?

blocks.zh: 偏差分類正確性：所有 Type 4/5 偏差都有 QA 簽名嗎？沒有自行升級為 Type 3 處理？
blocks.en: Correct deviation classification: do all Type 4/5 deviations have a QA signature? None were downgraded to Type 3 and handled on their own?

blocks.zh: 確效狀態啟動日期：是否有明確的 QA 簽名日期，且之後的所有變更都走了 CC？
blocks.en: Start date of the qualified state: is there a clear QA signature date, and did all subsequent changes go through CC?

blocks.zh: 品質系統要素：放行前 SOP 版本是否正確？培訓記錄是否完整？
blocks.en: Quality system elements: was the SOP version correct before release? Are the training records complete?

blocks.zh: PQ 先決條件鏈：IQ→OQ→週期開發→SOP→PQ 的順序是否有書面記錄？
blocks.en: PQ prerequisite chain: is the sequence IQ→OQ→cycle development→SOP→PQ documented?

blocks.zh: 觸發新確效評估的三個情境
blocks.en: Three Scenarios That Trigger a New Qualification Assessment

blocks.zh: 定期審查：每年/每3年，評估系統是否持續維持確效狀態，無需重測只需文件審查
blocks.en: Periodic review: every year/every 3 years, assess whether the system continues to maintain its qualified state; no retesting is needed, only a documentation review

blocks.zh: 計畫性變更：走品質變更控制，評估是否影響 CA/CDE，決定是否需要部分或全部重新確效
blocks.en: Planned change: goes through quality change control, assessing whether CAs/CDEs are affected and deciding whether partial or full requalification is needed

blocks.zh: 意外偏差：在測試中發現 Type 4/5 偏差，或日常監測中發現 OOS 趨勢，需啟動 CAPA
blocks.en: Unexpected deviation: a Type 4/5 deviation found during testing, or an OOS trend found in routine monitoring, requires a CAPA to be initiated
